synopsis: The older brother was a genius. At just 15 years old, he was already receiving offers from top teams around the world — a true “treasure of Japanese soccer.” Would it be Madrid or Barcelona? But the young prodigy made a surprising choice: he decided to attend “a Japanese high school where his underachieving younger brother would be enrolling.” “Because there’s someone amazing there that I want to play with!” With the “genius older brother” and the “underachieving younger brother,” let them stir up a storm in the world of soccer! In this world, only those who have a strong fighting spirit can communicate with the heavens and the earth. Born in Linshui, Chen Nan was an unparalleled genius with talent and thought he would become a great fighter in the future. However, Chen Nan was struck by lightning rays while practicing his martial arts and obtaining the spirit of divine battle, which was able to settle. To break the ultimate rule of Jang Lin, Qin Nan didn’t know that his fighting spirit possessed a great secret that would slowly discover mystery as the story continued.

synopsis: Ryou is in his last year of high school, and he's enjoying his otaku life to the fullest — except for a certain girl who's really getting on his nerves. She goes to his school and she's none other than his cocky two-year younger childhood-friend, Asahi-chan! Though she's suppose to be his kouhai, she's always teasing him whenever she gets the chance! On the other hand, if she gets teased back, she starts acting like "you can't say anything mean to me because I'm a cute girl." Furthermore, she's "afraid of people with practically no friends who can't be honest with their feelings." Someday, somehow, someone has to set this cocky Asahi-chan straight! synopsis: He was born fast. He had nothing else, only the ability to run fast. It gave him "a place at school" and "a bridge between friends." That was all the boy had. Then he met another boy who ran to forget the hardships in life. He was not fast by any means, but he had passion. The passion was infectious, and he gradually came to feel the same excitement. title: Moriagaranai Date
titleNative: 盛りあがらないデート
synopsis: A So-So Match on a Dating App… Haida, cursed with chronic bad luck, signs up for a dating app as part of her “what-the-heck” phase. She matches with Kuroi, a man who joined for equally reckless reasons. But their conversation never quite clicks, and an unmistakably low-key, awkward mood sets in. Everything they do backfires, resulting in a date that is astonishingly unexciting. Thinking there’s no way there will be a second date in an atmosphere like this… wait, what? Why are they making plans to meet again!? A first date with someone you met on a dating app that just doesn’t take off? The deadpan, surreal banter is way too addictive! A slow-burn, gently unfolding romance that begins with a dating app.
